record.category: debrid resale - account-only shop (explicitly not a key)

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable to the resale: the single-object cap is the debrid vendor's, not the shop's

retention.stated: not applicable to the resale: cached-item retention is the debrid vendor's

record.interface_detail: the shop delivers a voucher code or a login by email; the capacity itself is reached through the debrid vendor's REST API
record.tooling: any client that takes the vendor's API key: rclone, JDownloader, Stremio/Torrentio, pyload
record.chaining: a resold voucher only changes how the days are paid for; the stack above it is unchanged
record.binding_note: The product is an account whose email belongs to the seller; the vendor's location PIN goes to that mailbox, so the buyer's access is contingent on a third party at every new network.
record.confidence_note: the seller's page was read; a seller is not the vendor, so nothing here is at the documented rung except the vendor terms quoted in evidence

free_tier.stated: No free tier. The page states 'We DO NOT sell Real-debrid Premium Key, sell Account only', and on the read date shows 'There are no products matching the selection.'
free_tier.notes: the shop's own rating widget reports '4.5 out of 5 based on 2 reviews'

egress.terms: the page restates the vendor's feature list including 'Unlimited Traffic (4)' with the vendor's own footnote '(4) Except on some hosters'

limits.value: an account created by the seller; the buyer never holds the mailbox

identity_cost.detail: PayPal; delivery of account credentials by email

record.reliability_note: Two reviews is not a rating; the shop is out of stock, and the product it sells is the one shape the vendor's terms name ('managing it for somebody else').

evidence.proved: 'We DO NOT sell Real-debrid Premium Key, sell Account only', '4.5 out of 5 based on 2 reviews', and 'There are no products matching the selection.'
the shop still lists no product
evidence.quote: There are no products matching the selection.

evidence.proved: delivery is by email; the page title names a PayPal reseller
evidence.quote: We will send Real-debrid premium account to your email address.

evidence.proved: the shop still sells an account only, with no product in stock and 2 reviews
evidence.quote: We DO NOT sell Real-debrid Premium Key, sell Account only

record.notes: Included as the explicit statement of the account-only model: the shop tells the buyer the difference between a key and an account, which is the whole risk in one sentence.
